about_the_game:
Welcome to bloody summer camp.

We’re developing this game with a deep love for what inspired its creation,
A Spiritual Successor to Friday the 13th!

In this an asymmetric multiplayer horror experience, one player takes on the role of the Slaughter, a terrifying killer with inhuman abilities. 

The remaining players, up to seven Counselors, must work together (or betray each other) to survive and escape from the campside.

To do so, the counselors need to explore the map, find and collect key items, and repair escape vehicles such as a car or a boat. 
The Slaughter is always hunting, track, trap and execute them one by one!

Steam Deck is supported

🧣 Find, Collect, Use - Items That Could Save Your Life! 🪛

🫀 Support the project on Kickstarter and receive limited-edition gifts! (Soon) 👋🏼
The Kickstarter campaign isn’t live yet, but you can follow it now by tapping the 'Notify me on launch' button to be among the first to get notified.
Follow now: playsummercamp .com/kickstarter

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD 7870 2GB (with Vulkan support)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
